extracted.intended_audience: patent attorneys, litigants, judges, IP professionals, and parties using the Unified Patent Court
extracted.subtask_description: Index/listing of official legal instruments and procedural texts for the Unified Patent Court (UPC), including the UPCA, protocols, Rules of Procedure, and tables of court fees, with entry-into-force dates and downloadable language versions. Useful as a reference for practitioners and parties in UPC-related patent matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment UPCA (adopted 26 June 2023)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendment to the Unified Patent Court Agreement (UPCA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry into force: 2024-06-26. Available for download in EN/FR/DE pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement on a Unified Patent Court (UPCA)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agreement establishing the Unified Patent Court.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: UPC Agreement. Downloadable in EN/FR/DE pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protocol On Privileges and Immunities of the Unified Patent Court
rubrics_metrics.description: Protocol setting out privileges and immunities applicable to the UPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Protocols. Entry into force: 2021-10-27. Downloadable in EN/FR/DE pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protocol to the Agreement on a Unified Patent Court on provisional application
rubrics_metrics.description: Protocol concerning the provisional application of the UPCA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Protocols. Entry into force: 2022-01-19. Downloadable in EN/FR/DE pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrigendum to the Rules of Procedure, Table of Court Fees, Guidelines for determination of the Court Fees and the ceiling of recoverable costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Corrigendum and related adjustments affecting the Rules of Procedure, court fees table, and guidance on determination and recoverable costs ceiling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Rules of Procedure. Entry into force: 2026-02-26. Downloadable in EN pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amended Rules of Procedure of the Unified Patent Court
rubrics_metrics.description: Amended set of procedural rules governing UPC proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Rules of Procedure. Entry into force: 2026-01-01. Downloadable in EN/FR/DE pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules of Procedure of the Unified Patent Court
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary Rules of Procedure governing the conduct of proceedings before the UPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Rules of Procedure. Entry into force: 2022-09-01. Includes 'Genesis of the Rules of Procedure' historical note: principles approved 4 November 2006 at the Venice Forum; drafted 2009–2015 by a Drafting Committee (names listed); 17th draft discussed 26 Nov 2014 public hearing; 18th draft accepted 19 Oct 2015; amendments discussed Feb 2022 and adopted 8 July 2022 with entry into force 1 Sept 2022. Notes on French translation process and contributors are provided. Downloadable in EN/FR/DE pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amended Table of Court Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Revised table specifying court fees payable in UPC proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Table of Court Fees. Entry into force: 2026-01-01. Downloadable in EN/FR/DE pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table of Court Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Table setting out the court fees applicable under the UPC regime.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Table of Court Fees. Entry into force: 2022-09-01. Downloadable in EN/FR/DE pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation of a Presiding Judge of a Panel of the Court of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal document concerning designation of a presiding judge for an Appeal Panel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Legal. Entry into force: 2025-10-20. Downloadable in EN pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal document categories / filter taxonomy
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories used to classify and filter available legal documents on the UPC site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document Type filters shown on the page include: Legal Texts, UPC Agreement, Protocols, Rules of Procedure, Table of Court Fees, Presidium Documents, Legal, Templates of decisions and orders, Guidances, President Documents, President of the Court of Appeal, President of the Court of First Instance, Administrative Committee Documents, Legal, Finance, Human Resources, Appointments, Budget Committee, Budget Committee Documents, Advisory Committee, Advisory Committee Documents, PMAC documents, PMAC documents.
